k2_stream_host.note: K2 data-plane routes keep unknown stream scope and need their own stream-host acceptance; API-base credentials must never be reused here

limitations: bucket region is auto; an empty value and us-east-1 alias to auto, also for CreateBucket LocationConstraint
S3 access uses a separate endpoint and dedicated SigV4 credential type; only the credential type/template is registered, never a value
checksum support differs by type: CRC64NVME is FULL_OBJECT only while CRC32, CRC32C, SHA1 and SHA256 are COMPOSITE only
HeadObject Range is accepted but has no effect
CopyObject and UploadPartCopy have different conditional-request support; UploadPartCopy rejects copy-source conditional headers
UploadPart replaces the same part number, and a failed replacement loses the original part, which must be re-uploaded
ListObjects is supported but ListObjectsV2 is recommended for applications
multipart uploads need explicit abort/cleanup responsibility and recovery checks before retrying
x-amz-expected-bucket-owner, request payer and ACL headers are unsupported where the pinned table marks them ❌
